messages:
marie: Quick design check: proposing a 'peek-and-insert' affordance in the playground prompt library that shows a small "+N tokens" badge and a compact preview before inserting. Also thinking about a 'stream sentinel' toolbar: single tap Stop + token sentinel.

ash: Love the peek idea. Placement thoughts? We should avoid hovering over the message list.

marie: Inline next to each prompt in the library. Preview expands in-place; insert button has a tiny +N badge.

sam: Dev note: avoid reflow when showing preview. Render previews off-DOM or use transforms. Token badge updates should be debounced (200ms). Stop sends a cancel; regen is separate.

ben: Microcopy: show "+24" on the badge and tooltip "Adds 24 tokens". Insert action = "Insert" and menu item "Insert & focus". For stream sentinel primary label "Stop" tooltip "Stop generation (keep partial)".

kai: A11y: previews must not steal focus. Use aria-haspopup on the insert button and aria-expanded on open. Streaming region should be aria-live="polite". Token badges need aria-labels and non-color indicators.

a11y-bot: Checklist: keyboard-only preview, VoiceOver test with aria-expanded, contrast check for +N badge, reduced-motion support.

marie: UX risk: preview could push content. We should overlay previews and collapse on scroll. Also detect composer suggestions to avoid overlap.

ash: Add small fade and scale on open; honor prefers-reduced-motion.

sam: I'll prototype a non-blocking preview that uses position: absolute and updates token badge with a 200ms throttle.

ben: I'll draft microcopy for the badge, preview header, and the undo toast: "Response replaced \u2014 Undo".

kai: Will run a quick a11y sweep on the prototype focusing on aria-expanded and keyboard close behavior.

marie: Next: ash to update comps with peek preview and sentinel toolbar; sam prototype; ben copy; kai a11y pass. Will follow up in design sync.
